snippet.title: 27 Survivors // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4773130/27_Survivors

Over a century ago, you and 99 other passengers left Earth aboard a colony ship in stasis. Now, the ship has awakened you early and you find only you and 26 other passengers remain. Make repairs and keep yourself alive while you investigate what happened to the rest of the passengers.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: Steven Gann
📚 Publisher:  Steven Gann
📅 Release Date: Jul 18, 2026
🎯 Genre: Indie
